title: Hierarchical Successor Representation for Robust Transfer

layout.note: ten lettered panels in an irregular grid without frames: row 1 holds the derivation chain (a) and three goal maps (b); row 2 the RW-SR matrix with colour bar (c), eigenvector and option maps with key (d), and the eSR (e) and eHSR (f) matrices; row 3 three t-SNE plots (g) and three 2x2 groups of basis maps (h, i, j)

lesson: Pair a derivation chain of formula nodes (one colour per method, dashed versus dotted arrows for two decompositions) with result panels that reuse the same environment silhouette and the same method colours, so each symbol of the chain can be found as a picture.
